_comment: Antigravity MCP configuration. See docs/SETUP.md for the permission note:
MCP tools default to Ask mode in Antigravity, so `mcp(pair/*)` must be allowed in your
permissions policy or every pair_* call will stop for approval.
The role is baked in here on purpose. An agent must not be able to choose its own role,
because the whole write-authority boundary depends on the server knowing which process is which.
